profile_text.body:
Everway, formerly n2y and Texthelp, describes itself as a company working to break down barriers to learning and work through technology. Its site says its products are shaped by research, lived experience and feedback from its community, and that it serves learners from early years through higher education as well as employers. It lists instruction tools for teachers building differentiated lessons and assistive tools for use in the classroom, at college and in the workplace, with the stated aim of helping teachers build neuroinclusive classrooms and organizations support different ways of thinking. Product names given on the site include ULS, Inspire, News2you, Positivity, Classics, SymbolStix Prime, L3 Skills, Polaris, Read&Write, OrbitNote, Equatio, Global Tasks, WritingHelper, ClaroRead, uPar and AutoCorrect.

The tracked product in this record is Read&Write by Texthelp, listed under Education & Research AI. It is described as offering text-to-speech, prediction and translation, used by students and teachers. Deployment is by the school, which accepts the license terms on students' behalf, and it is noted as a Student Privacy Pledge signatory with many signed district agreements in the SDPC registry. Premium access is free for K-12 teachers, while student seats are priced per year with the amount available on quote.

The record contains no litigation, no MCP servers and no SEC or patent facts for the company.
